segments.text: She is the next head of the Azuma family and the eldest of four sisters. She is the head of St. Orkis Academy. She is a strong meritocrat, and does not recognize the value of existence in those who cannot produce results. She is also an excellent student and believes that if she can do it, others should be able to do it too. Her leadership is so severe that she sometimes uses corporal punishment, but no one can stop her. She is the reigning queen of the school.
Translated from the official site
東妻家の次期当主であり、四姉妹の長女。
聖オルキス学園の学園長。
優秀な学生を育成するため、自身も教壇に立つ。
強烈な能力主義者であり、結果を作り出せない者には存在価値を認めない。
自身も優秀であり、自分ができることは他人もできて当然と考えるタイプ。
そのために学園の生徒だけでなく教職員も、紫陽花を前にするとストレスで胃が縮む思いをするという。
その指導は時に体罰を用いるほど苛烈だが、誰もそれを止めることはできない。
正しく、学園に君臨する女王である。
学園を恐怖で支配する絶対者。

She is the second daughter of the Azuma family. She is a third-year student at St. Orkis Academy, where she is the student body president. She is very popular in the school because of her good-natured personality and sincere attitude toward everyone. She is more attached to the school than anyone else because her late father, who was a teacher, also loved the school. She believes that the current trend of female chauvinism is excessive, but from the standpoint of a student, she is troubled by the difficulty of improving the situation.
Translated from the official site
東妻家の次女。
聖オルキス学園三年生で、生徒会長を務めている。
朗らかで、そこにいるだけで場の空気を和ませる。
誰に対しても誠実に接し、人当たりも良いため、学内での人気は非常に高い。
学園に対しては、教師をしていた亡き父も愛していたということで誰よりも思い入れが強い。女子も男子も、皆が学園生活を楽しんでほしいという思いから生徒会活動に励んでいる。

Current head of the Azuma family. Chancellor of St. Orkis Academy. She is a noblewoman with a gentle smile and a graceful manner. She is the leader of the Azuma conglomerate, and manages a variety of companies. Orkis Academy is one of them. She is a very skilled manager, and the Azuma family has become very prosperous since she took over. Her husband died ten years ago, and she has lived a life without a man ever since.

その実、芯は強く冷静沈着な実業家である。

She is a loner who does not like to be part of a pack and goes her own way. She will not follow anything that is contrary to her own values. Because of her behavior and her outspoken opinions, she has a charismatic following among the lower class of the school caste, who are dissatisfied with the school. (She is not aware of it.)

She is a second-year student at St. Orkis Academy. She is a talented young actress who debuted as a child actress. She is usually reserved and modest, but her passion for acting is genuine. However, she was the victim of a malicious stalker and was forced to retire from the entertainment industry. During that time, she suffered from a phobia of men, which continues to torment her to this day. Nevertheless, she still harbors a passionate desire to return to acting.
Translated from the official site
聖オルキス学園二年生。
子役からデビューした実力派若手女優。
普段は控えめで慎み深いが、役者にかける情熱は本物。
舞台や映画のことになれば、自然と言葉に熱も入る。

その際に男性恐怖症を患い、今も苦しめられている。
それでも役者として復帰したいと、熱い思いを胸に秘めている。

Head of the fencing club. She is Suzuna's childhood friend and best friend. She is the vice-president of the student council, and supports Suzuna behind the scenes in both public and private matters. She rarely shows attentive concern for anyone other than Suzuna, and is strict with himself and others. She is very rough with male students and is rumored to be a man-hater, even to the point of promoting a female chauvinistic atmosphere.

She is the ace of the short-distance track and field team. She entered the school with a sports recommendation after achieving good results in national competitions during her junior high school years. She was bullied by a bully in the club, but was saved, and since then she has come to look up to Asami. She is a bright, positive, and hardworking person.

She is a second-year student at St. Orkis Academy. She is a sex slave of Kei (the main character) and an assistant to help him in training. She has a fake background and transferred to the academy ahead of Kei. She is absolutely obedient to Kei, but sometimes makes light talk and begs for training. She usually gives the impression of being friendly, but she is a true slave who faithfully obeys Kei's orders, no matter how lewd they may be.
Translated from the official site
聖オルキス学園二年生。
彗（主人公）の性奴隷であり、時には調教そのものや事前準備を手伝う助手でもある。 今回も彗の仕事をサポートするため、彗に先んじて聖オルキス学園に転入している。
主人である彗に対しては絶対服従だが、軽口を叩いたり調教をおねだりすることもある。
彗もそれを許しており、他の奴隷とは明らかに一線を画した存在となっている。
普段は人懐っこい印象を周囲に与えているが、彗の命令とあれば、どんな淫らな命令でも 忠実にこなす奴隷の鑑。

Kuga Kei is the one of the many illegitimate children belonging to his father. His father set him on a mission to sexually enslave the prestigious Azuma family, in a bid train the aristocrats.
Initially dismissive of such a request, Kei scoffed but upon closer inspection of the targets laid out for him he decided it to be a worthy undertaking after all...
